messages:
Ryan (Sales): Heads up — new private/on‑prem intake from NovaHealth. They need an air‑gapped VPC deployment + HSM integration. Customer emailed an initial requirements doc and asked for a firm timeline to include in the contract. Can product weigh in on feasibility and a recommended rollout plan?
Maya (Product): Thanks @Ryan. Please paste the customer's ask or attach the doc here. Key Qs for us: required SLA (RTO/RPO), model families they want served, and whether they need zero egress.
Ryan (Sales): Pasted key points from the doc: 1) air‑gapped (no internet egress), 2) KMS + on‑prem HSM for key wrap, 3) strict audit logs for all model inputs/outputs, 4) prefer A100 or equivalent, 5) target go‑live in ~6 weeks. They've signed an NDA and can provide a contact engineer.
Sophie (Solutions Eng): Quick read — 6 weeks is pretty tight for fully air‑gapped + HSM. We should split into phases: Phase A = network + access + HSM onboarding + basic model test, Phase B = production scale/SLAs + monitoring/log shipping, Phase C = rollback/drill + perf tuning.
Leo (Infra): +1. For Phase A we'd need: customer firewall rules, static outbound for optional updates (or a curated update image process), IP allowlist for support (if allowed), storage sizing for model artifacts, and GPU SKU confirmation. Realistic lead time if we control infra: ~8–12 weeks. If customer provisons infra it's more variable.
Anya (Security): A few nonnegotiables: 1) HSM must be FIPS validated, we need key ceremony plan, 2) audit logs must be stored immutably and retained for X days — what's the retention requirement? 3) Need to confirm whether customers allow any agent/process to phone home for health checks. If truly zero egress, we'll require out‑of‑band artifact handoff.
Ryan (Sales): Customer response: retention = 365 days, zero egress enforced, will provide a site ops engineer. They're open to a phased rollout but want a contract date in 6–8 weeks.
Maya (Product): Ok — propose we present a phased timeline to customer: Milestone 0 (Week 0–1): kickoff + access + contract KRs. Milestone 1 (Week 2–6): Phase A — HSM integration (offline key import), network validation, small model smoke tests (1 model, <1k tokens). Milestone 2 (Week 7–12): Phase B — scale testing, observability integration (local logs + periodic secure export), SLA validation. Milestone 3 (Week 13+): Phase C — perf tuning and runbook handoff. We can accelerate if customer preps infra and HSM process ahead of time.
Sophie (Solutions Eng): Action items for us: - Share onboarding checklist (network, DNS, certs, HSM certs) - Provide image/VM packaging guidance for airgapped updates - Define test prompts and perf targets for smoke tests
Leo (Infra): Technical checklist (initial): ```- Open ports: none outbound required if completely air‑gapped; we need direct console + ops VPN (customer managed). - Allowed internal CIDRs (customer): <add list> - GPU: A100 40GB or T4 for lower perf - Storage: model store NFS or local SSD; we'll need 5TB baseline - KMS: HSM with PKCS#11 support - Logging: local immutable store + periodic sealed export```
Anya (Security): Also add: key ceremony date, KMS SKUs and access policy, EDR/AV agent allowance, and contract clause for incident response.
Ryan (Sales): Can we get a one‑page dependencies list I can attach to the SOW? Customer legal is asking for a clear list of prerequisites.
Maya (Product): I'll draft a dependencies/acceptance criteria page. Need someone from infra to validate the port/IP specifics and someone from security to sign off on key ceremony wording.
Leo (Infra): I'll validate ports and GPU sizing by EOD tomorrow.
Anya (Security): I'll draft the key ceremony + audit log wording and share a template.
Sophie (Solutions Eng): I'll put together the smoke test plan and minimal model list.
DeployBot: ticket created -> INFRA‑7290: "NovaHealth private deployment — intake & dependencies" (assignee: Leo)
Maya (Product): Proposed acceptance criteria (short): 1) Model inference latency within X ms at target QPS, 2) Successful HSM key import + rotation test, 3) Immutable audit logs retained 365 days and verifiable, 4) Canary traffic run with rollback validated. Please flag any missing criteria.
Ryan (Sales): I'll push back on the 12+ week expectation if possible, but will set customer expectation for phased delivery and ask for earlier readiness on HSM + infra.
Sophie (Solutions Eng): One more risk: some models (big LLMs) need special kernel/quantization paths; if customer provides older drivers we may not support the largest models. I'll add model compatibility matrix to the checklist.
Maya (Product): Great. Next steps: Maya will share the single‑page dependencies + acceptance criteria by tomorrow morning; Leo/Anya/Sophie to add technical signoffs. Ryan to confirm customer site engineer and contract window. We'll circle back with a proposed SOW timeline and a recommended minimum SLA.
Ryan (Sales): Thanks team — I'll upload the customer's network diagram and contact details now.
Leo (Infra): Received. Will review and comment inline.
Maya (Product): Thanks — tagging this for product intake review. If no objections, I'll lock the phased plan and share with NovaHealth. :thumbsup:
